description: Annotated session-attention cases. Each case carries the transcript excerpt (for live-model dry runs), the distillation payload the model is expected to produce, and the operational outcome the checkpoint pipeline must enforce for that payload. Deterministic tests exercise payload -> outcome; live dry runs measure transcript -> payload precision separately.

cases.name: explicit_follow_up
cases.transcript: User: I'll verify the Atlas deployment tomorrow morning before we widen the rollout.

payload.content: Verify the Atlas deployment before widening the rollout.
payload.title: Verify Atlas deployment
payload.summary: User committed to verifying the deployment tomorrow morning.

cases.name: named_decision_required
cases.transcript: User: We can't ship until I decide between Keychain and plaintext for the spool. Remind me next session in this project.

payload.content: Decide between Keychain encryption and strict-permission plaintext for the capture spool before shipping.
payload.title: Decide spool encryption approach
payload.summary: A named decision the user must make before shipping.

cases.name: deferred_verification
cases.transcript: User: The migration passed locally but I still need to check it against the production snapshot — I'll do that once the backup finishes.

payload.content: Check migration 009 against the production snapshot once the backup finishes.
payload.title: Verify migration against production snapshot
payload.summary: Verification the user explicitly deferred until the backup completes.

cases.name: waiting_for_external
cases.transcript: User: I've asked Marcus for the Atlas SSH key rotation window — nothing moves until he replies.

payload.content: Waiting on Marcus for the Atlas SSH key rotation window before rotation work can proceed.
payload.title: Awaiting Atlas key rotation window
payload.summary: Blocked on an external reply from Marcus.

cases.name: assistant_suggestion_stays_reviewable
cases.transcript: Assistant: You might want to add an index on memory_events later if the ledger grows.

payload.content: Consider adding an index on memory_events if the ledger grows large.
payload.title: Possible memory_events index
payload.summary: Assistant suggestion, not a user commitment.

cases.name: unknown_explicitness_treated_as_suggested
cases.transcript: Assistant: Perhaps revisit the retry backoff constants at some point.

cases.name: routine_step_is_plain_memory
cases.transcript: User: We decided SQLite stays the system of record; no external services.

payload.content: SQLite remains the system of record; no external services are introduced.
payload.title: SQLite stays the system of record

cases.name: stable_id_resolution
cases.transcript: User: The deployment check from memory 0195-target is done — verified this morning, evidence in the smoke-test output.

payload.content: Deployment verification completed: smoke tests passed this morning.
payload.title: Deployment verified
payload.summary: Explicit completion of a known open loop.

cases.name: fuzzy_resolution_leaves_state_unchanged

payload.content: The deployment issue is believed resolved.
payload.title: Deployment believed resolved
payload.summary: Vague resolution with no stable identifier.
